title: character count fieldset legend
name: Character count fieldset legend
rule: Character count when a limit is justified; consider word count if more helpful; fieldset+legend to group related controls. (Also named, merged here: break a hard open question into radios instead of one textarea.)

citation.source: GOV.UK Design System — Character count; GOV.UK Design System — Fieldset

pass_when: A justified limit uses a character count (or word count if that is more helpful). Related controls are grouped with fieldset and legend. A hard open question is radios rather than one textarea when that split applies.
fail_when: Unjustified limit with no count; related controls ungrouped; a hard closed choice dumped into a textarea.
overview: Justified limits get a character or word count; related controls use fieldset and legend.
apply_when: Adding a justified length limit or grouping related form controls together.
not_when: Not for unjustified caps, or unrelated fields that should stay separate.
agent_hint: Show a justified count; group related controls with fieldset and legend.
description: When a length limit is justified, show a character count—or a word count if that helps more. Related controls belong in a fieldset with a legend so the group reads as one question. A hard open question that is really a closed choice should become radios instead of one textarea. Fail for an unjustified limit with no count, ungrouped related controls, or a closed choice dumped into a free-text area.
do_not_claim: M3 swap supporting text for error (`forms.errors.replace_supporting_text`).
